messages:
maria_customer: Hey team — we're seeing a lot of 429s and huge tail latency on our Dedicated pool (dedicated-us-east-3a-pool-42) since ~09:15. Throughput dropped, requests spike to 1.2s p50 -> 5-8s p99, lots of "`MIG_NOT_AVAILABLE`" style errors in client logs. Any chance this is noisy neighbor / GPU contention?

john_support: Sorry you're hitting this, that's not expected. Can you paste a request id and the model/variant + batch/seq config? Also are you on dedicated reserved capacity or shared-dedicated?

maria_customer: Request IDs: r-0a2f9c, r-0a2f9d, r-0a2fa1. Model: gpt-small-emu:v1. Batch size 1, max_tokens 1024, streaming on. This is Reserved Dedicated pool (we procured dedicated capacity last quarter).

john_support: Thanks. Reproducing locally — can you run one failing curl so we have a repro? Example: 

curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \ \ 
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <KEY>' \ \ 
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \ \ 
  -d '{"model":"gpt-small-emu:v1","input":"test latency","max_tokens":1024}' 

and paste the full response + headers if possible.

maria_customer: Pasting one response: 
{"error":"MIG_NOT_AVAILABLE","message":"scheduled instance unavailable, fallback queued","request_id":"r-0a2f9c"} 
Headers: x-rw-latency: 5123ms; x-rw-node: node-42.us-east-3a

ryan_sre: I pulled the internal logs for node-42.us-east-3a. We're seeing repeated MIG partition mismatches — a large job created many vGPU contexts on the same physical GPU causing fragmentation. Autoscaler tried to spin extra nodes but didn't due to a label selector mismatch for the pool. Stack snippet from runtime: 

```
2024-11-14T09:16:02Z runtime: attach_mig_partition failed: partition_busy
2024-11-14T09:16:02Z runtime: fallback -> enqueue request (queue_len=48)
2024-11-14T09:16:05Z autoscaler: would_scale_up=true but node_labels match=false (pool=dedicated-us-east-3a expected=pool-42)
```

ryan_sre: So two issues: noisy job hogging vGPU slices and autoscaler prevented new nodes due to config mismatch. We'll need infra to fix autoscaler policy and recommend a workaround for you.

iris_infra: @ryan_sre thanks — I see the label bug in the autoscaler config map. Fixing now (small change to selector: pool -> pool_id). Deploying patch to autoscaler. ETA ~10m.

john_support: For immediate mitigation: can you try pinning traffic to a different pool or temporarily set `prefer_isolation=true` on your tenant config? That will route your requests to isolated nodes and avoid shared scheduling. To set: 

1) Console -> Dedicated -> Pools -> dedicated-us-east-3a-pool-42 -> Advanced -> prefer_isolation = true
2) Or via API: 
```
POST /v1/dedicated/pools/42/config
{ "prefer_isolation": true }
```

maria_customer: Ok toggled prefer_isolation to true. So far p50 down to 320ms, p99 ~610ms. No more MIG_NOT_AVAILABLE errors in last 3 mins. Thanks.

ryan_sre: Good — we'll keep the autoscaler patch rolling. Post-deploy we'll run an eviction-reschedule to clear the fragmented partitions and then suggest a permanent setting: stricter affinity rules for heavy jobs + increasing min_nodes for that pool.

iris_infra: Autoscaler patch deployed. Opening infra ticket INF-2024-891 with root cause and follow-ups: adjust label schema, add CV to detect MIG fragmentation, and add proactive rescheduler. CC: @oncall-bot

oncall-bot: Incident created INF-2024-891. Priority: P2. Assigned: iris_infra, ryan_sre.

john_support: I'll update the customer ticket with the repro steps and mitigation. Action items: 
- infra: confirm reschedule completed and monitor for 1 hour (iris_infra)
- sre: propose autoscaler test to validate selectors (ryan_sre)
- support: follow up with customer in 30m (john_support)

maria_customer: Appreciate the fast turnaround. Please keep me posted on the permanent fix. If you need a sample heavy job we can share to help repro in staging.

ryan_sre: We'll take you up on that — staging test would help tune min_nodes and vGPU partition defaults. Thanks all.
